Class RemoteView

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.core.env.RemoteView
public final class RemoteView extends Object
Another player as a game client shows it. A client never has the other player's true position: the server sends it every second tick, and the client glides towards the last one it was sent over three ticks. What is drawn, and what a click is tested against, is that gliding copy. It trails the real player by a few ticks and moves smoothly even when the real one does not.

A fighter that learned on a real client has only ever seen such a copy, so a body without a client is shown one too, built here by the same rules (1.21.11: players are sent every 2 ticks, InterpolationHandler takes 3 steps, RemotePlayer animates its walk from how far the copy itself moved).
